name: farert-wasm
description: Japanese railway fare calculation system fully ported to WebAssembly with 39 APIs

scripts.build: npm run build:wasm && npm run build:cli
scripts.build:cli: npm run build:cli:check && node scripts/enhanced-tsc-build.js tsconfig.cli.json
scripts.build:wasm:check: node -e "const fs=require('fs'); if (!fs.existsSync('dist/farert.js')||!fs.existsSync('dist/farert.wasm')) { console.error('❌ WebAssembly artifacts missing. Run: npm run build:wasm'); process.exit(1); } console.log('✅ WebAssembly artifacts detected');"
scripts.test:browser: echo 'Open http://localhost:8080/test_unit.html in browser after running: npm run serve'
scripts.cli:exec: npm run cli:build && node dist/cli/cli/main.js -exec || npm run cli:build:error-report
scripts.cli:test-extended: npm run cli:build && node dist/cli/cli/test_wasm_extended.js || npm run cli:build:error-report
scripts.cli:test-all: npm run cli:build && node dist/cli/cli/test_integration.js || npm run cli:build:error-report
scripts.cli:build:error-report: node -e "console.error('\n❌ CLI Build Error Details:'); console.error('📁 Please check TypeScript compilation errors above'); console.error('💡 Common solutions:'); console.error('  - Run: npm run build:wasm  (if WebAssembly artifacts missing)'); console.error('  - Check file paths in src/cli/ directory'); console.error('  - Verify tsconfig.cli.json configuration'); process.exit(1);"
scripts.ci:build: npm run ci:check-env && npm run build
scripts.ci:test: npm run ci:build && npm run ci:test-exec
scripts.ci:test-exec: npm run cli:exec && echo '✅ CI Test Execution: SUCCESS (Exit Code: 0)' || (echo '❌ CI Test Execution: FAILED (Exit Code: 1)' && exit 1)
scripts.ci:check-env: node -e "console.log('🔍 CI Environment Check:'); const checks=[{name:'Node.js',cmd:()=>process.version,required:'>=14.0.0'},{name:'NPM',cmd:()=>require('child_process').execSync('npm -v',{encoding:'utf8'}).trim(),required:'>=6.0.0'}]; let allPassed=true; checks.forEach(check=>{try{const version=check.cmd(); console.log('  ✅',check.name+':',version); if(check.required && !version.match(/\d+/)) allPassed=false;}catch(e){console.log('  ❌',check.name+': NOT FOUND'); allPassed=false;}}); if(!allPassed){console.error('❌ CI Environment checks failed'); process.exit(1);} console.log('✅ CI Environment: All checks passed');"
scripts.ci:status: node -e "const fs=require('fs'),path=require('path'); console.log('📊 CI Build Status Report:'); console.log('=========================================='); const artifacts=[{name:'WebAssembly JS',path:'dist/farert.js'},{name:'WebAssembly WASM',path:'dist/farert.wasm'},{name:'CLI Build',path:'dist/cli/cli/main.js'}]; let allPresent=true; artifacts.forEach(a=>{const exists=fs.existsSync(a.path); console.log('  '+(exists?'✅':'❌')+' '+a.name+': '+(exists?'PRESENT':'MISSING')); if(!exists) allPresent=false;}); console.log('------------------------------------------'); console.log('📋 Overall Status: '+(allPresent?'✅ READY':'❌ INCOMPLETE')); if(!allPresent) process.exit(1);"

author: Farert Development Team
